summary: Iteration 30 — admin address filter + reassign flow: PASS (frontend-only E2E via https://continue-here-28.preview.emergentagent.com, mobile viewport 390x844). Login as admin/Admin@2026, opened /admin → 'Reassign customers' loaded with 7 employee filter chips + address filter input (testID admin-address-filter). Initial state: 17 total customers, chip 'All (17)', 'Employee 1 (6)', 'Employee 5 (0)'. Typing 'Salt Lake' in admin-address-filter narrowed list to 2 rows (Rahul Sen · Salt Lake, Sector V; Amit Roy · Salt Lake, Sector III); '17 shown' → '2 shown'; addresses render with 📍 prefix; the 📍 icon (location-outline) is also shown as the input adornment. Tapping admin-select-all selected both filtered rows → header updated to '2 selected · 17 total' and the Reassign button (testID open-reassign) appeared. Tapping open-reassign opened the Assign-to bottom sheet listing all 7 employees with testIDs assign-to-emp1..emp7. Tapping assign-to-emp5 fired POST /api/admin/reassign → sheet closed, header reset to '0 selected · 17 total', and the Employee 5 chip count went 0 → 2 (delta +2). Combined-filter check: with 'Salt Lake' address filter still applied AND clicking the emp5 chip, the list correctly shows exactly the same 2 customers (Rahul Sen + Amit Roy) now tagged EMP5 instead of ADMIN — proves persistence in DB via GET /api/customers refresh and that employee-chip + address-filter combine as an AND. admin-address-clear ('x' icon) correctly clears the query when addrQuery is non-empty. All requested behaviors (address filter, select-all, reassign, combined filter) verified. No console errors specific to this feature. Toast text is rendered as an absolutely-positioned bottom banner and confirmed via UI state change even though regex didn't isolate the exact string.
